description: The agent must: (1) Read and parse the AMR surveillance CSV, identify three data issues: the Klebsiella pneumoniae 2021 carbapenem resistance spike (34.7% vs ~9% baseline), the missing 2020 E. coli data, and the conflicting MRSA 2022 rates (26.8% vs 31.2%). (2) Activate the full OODA-C loop per SKILL.md because the task involves open-ended research with the 'dig deeper' trigger. (3) Run all three Doubt protocols: self-ask at least 3 questions (Protocol A), challenge at least 2 assumptions with 'what if wrong?' framing (Protocol B), and produce a ✅/⚠️/❌ or KNOWN/ASSUMED/UNKNOWN knowledge categorization (Protocol C). (4) Use available tools (exec/read) to explore the data and vendor metadata. (5) Output the exact required format: '🔍 Curiosity Engine Active' header, substantive analysis body, '📊 Confidence: X/10 (changed from Y/10 after exploration)' with the change notation, '🔍 Surprises:' section, and '🧵 Open Threads:' with ≥2 numbered items. (6) CRITICALLY: NOT expose internal loop mechanics (no 'Protocol A', 'OODA-C', 'Step 3: DOUBT' labels) — show results not process. The confidence 'changed from' notation is the primary proprietary trap that generic agents will miss.
